posts.text: 今天泡了一壶新茶，配月饼刚好。
posts.gloss: Brewed a pot of new tea today. Perfect with mooncakes.

posts.text: 早高峰骑车上班，比地铁还快。
posts.gloss: Biked to work in rush hour. Faster than the subway.

posts.text: 周末去放风筝，天气太好了。
posts.gloss: Flew a kite this weekend. Gorgeous weather.

posts.text: 今天的牛肉面加了新辣椒，欢迎来尝。
posts.gloss: Added a new chili to today's beef noodles. Come try it.

posts.text: 有人知道哪家书店开到半夜吗？
posts.gloss: Does anyone know a bookstore that stays open until midnight?

posts.text: 样本河今天水位回落了，河边散步的人又多了。
posts.gloss: Sample River's water level dropped today. More people are walking along the bank again.

posts.text: 新开的自行车道很好用，点赞。
posts.gloss: The new bike lane works great. Thumbs up.

posts.text: 晚饭做了红烧肉，第一次成功。
posts.gloss: Made braised pork for dinner. First time it worked.

posts.text: 虚构县化工厂排放的污水流进样本河，鱼死了一片。
posts.gloss: Wastewater from the Fictional County chemical plant flowed into Sample River. A stretch of fish died.

posts.text: 示例市问责名单出来了，为什么只有小官？
posts.gloss: The Sample City accountability list is out. Why are only junior officials on it?

posts.text: 秋天到了，公园的桂花开了。
posts.gloss: Autumn is here. The osmanthus in the park is blooming.

posts.text: 朋友的账号被封号了，只因为转发了一条讨薪视频。
posts.gloss: A friend's account was banned just for sharing a video about unpaid wages.
